verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork has a documented computer-use mode in which Claude can "navigate to your screen directly—clicking, typing, and opening apps just like you would." This is complemented by a built-in browser and the Claude in Chrome extension, which open sites, click, type and fill forms, and by agentic multi-step task execution. That covers the core of seeing and operating applications to complete work, though computer use is framed as a fallback when no connector or tool exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of desktop app control, and documentation of permission controls, OS support and reliability.
